messages:
maria: Kicking off rollout for v3.2.1-delta — US then EU then APAC. Short change window (00:00-03:00 PT). Draining slice-a in us-west now.
jason: copy. how aggressive is the drain? we don't want 503s on low-cap jobs.
maria: gentle drain: 25% traffic shift every 3m with a 10m observation at each step. holdpoints at 25/50/75 before region cutover.
kevin: confirming capacity cushion: warm pool + reserve = 18 GPUs for US, 10 for EU, 6 for APAC. margin = ~22%.
amelia: FYI EU legal team requested no config changes during their maintenance window at 01:00-01:30 UTC. we'll time EU cutover after that.
sre-oncall: putting manual hold thresholds: error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency increase > 30% = auto-hold. rollback trigger = sustained error-rate > 2% for 5m.
deploy-bot: @channel deploy request accepted: v3.2.1-delta -> staged slices [slice-a]. Execution plan: US -> EU -> APAC.
capacity-checker-bot: preflight ok: US(18/14) warm/available, EU(10/8), APAC(6/5). note: APAC reported one degraded node in ap-south-1, not in slice-a.
jason: thanks bot. can we pin the fallback model for EU in case we hit capacity? pin to v3.2.0-stable.
maria: yes will configure pin for EU. fallback policy: v3.2.0-stable, immediate fallback for >=50% throttle on queue lengths.
kevin: one ask: add extra KV-cache warming in US before cutting traffic to 50%. avoids cold kv spikes.
amelia: +1 -- KV pre-warm scheduled now for 6m prior to 50% step.
deploy-bot: US canary started at 00:12 PT. canary slice: 0.5% traffic. logs:
```
[deploy-bot] 00:12:12 canary-start slice-a us-west-2 v3.2.1-delta
[deploy-bot] 00:13:01 canary-metrics p95=142ms err=0.1% tokens=3.2k
```
maria: canary looks healthy. proceeding to step 25% after KV-warm completes.
capacity-checker-bot: after canary: US available GPUs=16, warm pool used=4, estimated headroom=+12 GPUs (good).
sre-oncall: keep an eye on autoscaler activity — don't let it preempt spot reclaim cycles during drain.
jason: moving traffic to 25% now.
maria: US 25% stable for 10m. no anomalies. moving to 50%.
deploy-bot: US 50% applied. log snippet:
```
[deploy-bot] 00:36:40 step-apply traffic=50% slice-a us-west-2
[deploy-bot] 00:38:22 step-observe p95=165ms err=0.3%
```
kevin: EU preflight check inbound — running capacity assertion and legal window check.
capacity-checker-bot: EU assertion: prior limit is 10 GPUs reserved, after pin and burst plan will keep 3 GPUs free for emergency: projected headroom 5 GPUs. maintenance window cleared.
amelia: scheduling EU cutover 01:45 UTC to avoid their 01:00-01:30 block.
jason: any concerns for APAC given the degraded node noted earlier?
capacity-checker-bot: APAC degraded node cleared at 00:55 PT. but recommend staggered ramp there: 10% -> 25% -> 50% with 8m observation windows.
maria: agreed. EU cutover now commencing, pin fallback in place. watch for any cross-region traffic surge.
deploy-bot: EU canary started at 01:47 UTC.
deploy-bot: EU metrics: p95=190ms err=0.4% tokens=1.1k.
sre-oncall: small error spike at 01:55 UTC on a single host (app-proxy-12). isolating and routing around it.
maria: hold EU at 25% until proxy fix in the next 7m.
kevin: proxy fix deployed and validated, rolling out EU 50% now.
jason: all green in EU at 50% for 12m. proceeding to full 100% slice ownership for slice-a in EU.
capacity-checker-bot: EU full-cutover predicted headroom +2 GPUs; please monitor cost spike if autoscale engages.
amelia: APAC ramp starting in 10m per ops plan.
deploy-bot: APAC canary 10% applied at 03:05 PT.
deploy-bot: APAC logs:
```
[deploy-bot] 03:05:12 canary-start ap-southeast-1 v3.2.1-delta
[deploy-bot] 03:12:47 canary-metrics p95=210ms err=0.9%
```
sre-oncall: APAC error-rate trending up to 1.4% at 03:18. holding at 10%. investigating memory pressure on model-host-7.
kevin: memory pressure correlates with longer sequences from an internal test run — blocked job, killing the runaway job.
maria: after kill and soft-restart host, metrics recover to p95=195ms err=0.4%. resume to 25%.
jason: APAC 25% -> 50% after 8m stable. no further incidents.
sre-oncall: final check: all regions in stable state. error-rate < 0.5% across slices, p95 within expected thresholds.
maria: great. schedule post-mortem notes: small EU proxy incident and APAC runaway test job. no rollback needed. updating release notes and tagging canary artifacts.
amelia: I'll draft a short release note for customers outlining change window and fallback policy.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: v3.2.1-delta promoted to slice-a across US/EU/APAC.
maria: thanks team. leaving warm pool for 90m as cushion. closing thread. :tada:
